# JsBarcode

`JsBarcode.code128.min.js` is the pinned Code 128 browser build from JsBarcode 3.11.6. It is served locally so printing does not depend on a CDN.

Source: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode

Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsbarcode@3.11.6/dist/barcodes/JsBarcode.code128.min.js

License: `JsBarcode-MIT-LICENSE.txt` (MIT).

## PDF.js

`pdf.min.js` and `pdf.worker.min.js` are the pinned PDF.js 3.11.174 browser builds, loaded only when a footer document opens. The classic-script build supports the existing static site's browser setup. Evaluation is disabled and document URLs are restricted to the known local PDF assets.

Source: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/

License: `PDFjs-LICENSE.txt` (Apache 2.0).
